minWidth.label: Node Min Width
minWidth.desc: Minimum display width of the node when text is short. Prevents layout jitter.

maxWidth.label: Node Max Width
maxWidth.desc: Maximum width of the node. Content will wrap if exceeded.

height.label: Node Height
height.desc: Base height of the node. Will expand for multi-line text.

horizontal.label: Node Horizontal Padding
horizontal.desc: Left and right padding for node content.

vertical.label: Node Vertical Padding
vertical.desc: Top and bottom padding for node content.

sideSafeGap.label: Domain Side Safe Gap
sideSafeGap.desc: Extra margin on domain sides for safety.

bottomSafeGap.label: Domain Bottom Safe Gap
bottomSafeGap.desc: Extra margin at the bottom of the domain.

height.label: Domain Title Height
height.desc: Reserved height for domain title bar.

safeGap.label: Domain Title Safe Gap
safeGap.desc: Safe gap between title and content.

height.label: SubDomain Title Height
height.desc: Reserved height for sub-domain title bar.

ensureTitleClearance.label: Ensure Title Clearance
ensureTitleClearance.desc: Automatically shift content to avoid title overlap.

horizontal.label: Horizontal Node Spacing
horizontal.desc: Horizontal distance between nodes in the same layer.

directionalHandlePolicy.label: Handle Direction Policy
directionalHandlePolicy.desc: Strategy for handle placement (prefer, force, off).

forceDirect.label: Force Direct
forceDirect.desc: Ignore obstacles and force direct path.

intraContainerNoObstacle.label: No Obstacles in Container
intraContainerNoObstacle.desc: Ignore internal obstacles for intra-container edges.

pureObstacleMode.label: Pure Obstacle Mode
pureObstacleMode.desc: Ignore container walls, consider only node obstacles.

laneClamp.label: Enable Lane Clamp
laneClamp.desc: Restrict path to container lane when within same container.

minArrowOffset.label: Min Arrow Offset
minArrowOffset.desc: Minimum offset for arrow from node boundary.

stepLastSegmentMin.label: Step Last Segment Min
stepLastSegmentMin.desc: Minimum length for the final segment of a step line.

disableDomainInfluence.label: Disable Domain Influence
disableDomainInfluence.desc: Remove domain preferences, use geometry/obstacles only.

crossDomainVerticalPrefer.label: Cross-Domain Vertical Prefer
crossDomainVerticalPrefer.desc: Prefer vertical ports for cross-domain edges.

preferLROnHorizontal.label: Prefer LR on Horizontal
preferLROnHorizontal.desc: Prefer Left-Right ports for horizontal flow.

orthogonalSamplingEnabled.label: Enable Orthogonal Sampling
orthogonalSamplingEnabled.desc: Use multi-channel sampling for step paths.

orthogonalSampleBudget.label: Orthogonal Sample Budget
orthogonalSampleBudget.desc: Max number of candidates for sampling.

gridAStarEnabled.label: Enable Grid A*
gridAStarEnabled.desc: Use Grid A* for pathfinding candidates.

beziersAllowedMinAngleDeg.label: Bezier Min Angle
beziersAllowedMinAngleDeg.desc: Min angle to allow bezier curves.

beziersAllowedMinDetourRatio.label: Bezier Min Detour Ratio
beziersAllowedMinDetourRatio.desc: Min detour ratio to allow bezier curves.

corridorObstacleHardThreshold.label: Corridor Obstacle Threshold
corridorObstacleHardThreshold.desc: Obstacle count threshold to fallback to bezier.

direction.label: Domain Layout Direction
direction.desc: Direction of the global layout (LR, TB, etc.).

nodeStrategy.label: Node Layout Strategy
nodeStrategy.desc: Strategy for laying out nodes within domains.

ELK_STRICT_MODE.label: ELK Strict Mode
ELK_STRICT_MODE.desc: Strictly follow ELK output, disable post-processing.

ELK_PORT_BORDER_OFFSET.label: ELK Port Border Offset
ELK_PORT_BORDER_OFFSET.desc: Offset of ports from node border.

ELK_MERGE_EDGES.label: ELK Merge Edges
ELK_MERGE_EDGES.desc: Merge multiple edges between same nodes.
